decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $5 primary-mint allocation and identifies the Small Block pool as the sole active prize pool.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the affected FAQ content and records the revised $5/$5/$5 allocation.
The existing same-message MODIFY already narrows the no-code ticket award to a Small Block prize ticket; the trigger, recipient eligibility, and commission remain unchanged.
Eliminating Big Blocks and reallocating mint revenue does not change which NFT asset must be minted and delivered.
The decision does not change the deferred Transak provider, fiat payment flow, supported methods, wallet provisioning, or mint delivery behavior.
The revised base-mint revenue allocation does not change the independently optional tipping control or its placement.
The source preserves the recurring $500 Small Block prizes and does not change the current winner count, prize amount, eligibility window, or 100-sale trigger.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter key while preserving the still-valid Small Block counter, badges, and referral-code metadata.
The existing same-message MODIFY already narrows eligible winners to Small Block ticket holders; Chainlink VRF and the remaining fairness rules are unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the dual-block ticket award with one Small Block ticket while preserving the $5 referral commission.

The existing same-message MODIFY already removes obsolete Big Block eligibility, reset, and counter-independence keys, narrows scope to Small Block tickets, and retains the operational fact that the Big Block lifecycle was removed.
